name: N-Ethyl-2C-B
summary: N-Ethyl-2C-B, also known as 2C-B-E, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and 2C families related to 2C-B. It is the N-ethyl derivative of 2C-B.

pharmacology.text: The drug shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors (Ki = 40–330 nM and 1,930 nM, respectively). Its affinities for these receptors were 10–40-fold and 54-fold lower than those of 2C-B, respectively.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It was encountered as a novel designer drug in Finland in 2007.
